stories.label: Iran-US nuclear standoff — Trump open to 'token' deal while strike plans target Khamenei
stories.summary: Trump reportedly open to 'token' enrichment if all bomb paths blocked — walkback from zero enrichment. Pentagon has strike plans targeting Khamenei and son. Iran counterproposal expected in 2-3 days. ~3 days left on ultimatum.

stories.label: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire collapse — Hezbollah declares resistance only option
stories.summary: Hezbollah declared 'resistance' the only option after 10+ killed in Israeli strikes. Senior official killed in Bekaa Valley. Ceasefire effectively dead with near-daily Israeli strikes.

stories.label: US tariff upheaval — Supreme Court strikes down tariffs, Section 122 takes effect Monday
stories.summary: Supreme Court struck down emergency tariffs 6-3. Trump invoked Section 122 for 10% global tariff effective Feb 24. EU scrambling to respond. Global markets recalculating. Constitutional confrontation deepening.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia conflict — Ukraine targets Russian missile production
stories.summary: Ukraine struck a missile production facility deep inside Russia. Diplomatic talks stalled since third Geneva round. Military escalation continues from both sides.

stories.label: Ethiopia-Tigray-Eritrea: Troop movements raise renewed conflict fears
stories.summary: Bloomberg reports military troop movements near Eritrea-Tigray border. 2022 Pretoria peace agreement may be unraveling. Tigray war killed 300-500K people.

stories.label: US scientists organize to protect research from political pressure
stories.summary: At the AAAS annual meeting — the world's largest general science gathering — the dominant theme is how to protect research, data, and institutional independence from political interference.

stories.label: China's tech giants recruit AI and semiconductor talent in the US
stories.summary: Chinese tech companies aggressively recruiting AI and semiconductor talent in the US, even as both governments restrict technology flows. Corporate recruitment undermining containment strategies.

stories.label: Pakistan NW security crisis — soldiers killed in Bannu suicide attack
stories.summary: Lieutenant colonel and another soldier killed in suicide attack in Bannu, NW Pakistan. Militant attacks surging in the region.

stories.label: India-Brazil critical minerals deal to reduce China dependence
stories.summary: India and Brazil signed critical minerals/rare earths cooperation agreement during Lula's Delhi visit. Part of Global South supply chain diversification away from China's ~80% monopoly.

stories.label: Venezuela grants amnesty to 379 political prisoners
stories.summary: Venezuela granted amnesty to 379 political prisoners. Fast-track protocol now in place for further releases. Thousands still detained.

stories.label: Albania clashes as protesters demand PM Rama resign
stories.summary: Violent protests near Albania's parliament. Demonstrators demand Rama resign over corruption. Watch for escalation.

stories.label: Trump to visit China March 31-April 2 for summit with Xi
stories.summary: White House announces Trump will visit China March 31-April 2. First face-to-face with Xi this term.

stories.label: Sudan genocide and humanitarian crisis
stories.summary: RSF drone killed 3 aid workers. UN crossed genocide threshold. Museveni hosting RSF leader Dagalo for dialogue.

stories.label: EU excludes China from critical tech research programmes
stories.summary: EU excluded Chinese researchers and institutions from AI, semiconductor, and critical tech programmes. Aligns with US containment strategy.

stories.label: Nigeria Lassa fever outbreak — 22% fatality rate
stories.summary: Lassa fever outbreak in Nigeria at 22% case fatality rate with 15 healthcare workers infected.

stories.label: Giant tortoises return to Galapagos island after century
stories.summary: 150+ giant tortoises reintroduced to Floreana Island. Decades-long breeding programme success.

stories.label: US to reopen embassy in Syria after 14 years
stories.summary: US State Department notified Congress of intent to reopen Damascus embassy.

stories.label: Thailand election may be voided over barcode blunder
stories.summary: Annulment threat over barcode printing error in ballots. Court ruling expected soon.

stories.label: US ambassador endorses Israeli expansion across Middle East
stories.summary: US ambassador Huckabee told Tucker Carlson it would be 'fine' if Israel expanded from Nile to Euphrates. Arab states and Muslim groups condemned.

stories.label: Saudi-UAE rift over Sudan RSF and Yemen STC
stories.summary: MBS sent detailed complaint to UAE over Emirati support for Sudan's RSF and Yemen's STC.

stories.label: OpenAI flagged school shooter but did not alert police
stories.summary: OpenAI flagged shooter's account months before Canadian school shooting but chose not to alert police.

stories.label: DeepMind spinoff unveils 'AlphaFold 4' for drug discovery
stories.summary: Isomorphic Labs released new AI model for full molecular interaction modeling.

stories.summary: NASA targeting early March for Artemis II — first crewed mission beyond Earth orbit since Apollo 17.

stories.summary: Kim Ju-ae absent from rare party congress. Succession questions.
